Author: dajoey
Name: Lazy Skyward Tracker
Description: Tracks all jobs' Skyward points for the Pteranodon mount achievement. Scans your inventory for Skybuilders turn-in items and projects how many points they'll add, shown as a cyan bar extension on each job's progress bar. Use /lazysky to open.
Punchline: Track your Skyward points for all jobs toward the Pteranodon mount
Changelog:
v0.0.3.6 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The window was polished for the real in-game font and scale: text no longer clips or sits against card borders.
- Job rows and the Refresh button keep a clear margin inside their card edges, so the points text no longer sits against the border.
- Job rows are compact and vertically centred, with the job, achievement, progress bar and points aligned on one line.
- Stat cards show a larger value at the same height; cards with a real ratio get a green progress bar and the inventory card shows no empty track.
- The header has a bordered brand chip, a rounded status pill with only the state word and a drawn close button with a Close tooltip; log-in and no-data messages are tinted, rounded notices, and the footer stays visible even at the minimum size.

v0.0.3.5 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The tracker window now has a close button in its header, placed beside the status pill, and the redundant outer scrollbar is gone. The job list keeps its own scrolling for narrow windows. Tracking, settings, commands and refresh behaviour are unchanged.

v0.0.3.4 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The tracker window shows job progress, inventory projections and completion state in a responsive card-based layout: a custom header without the native title bar, summary and job-progress cards, job rows that adapt to the window width, and a persistent footer with the live state. Tracking, settings, commands and refresh behaviour are unchanged.

v0.0.3.3 (2026-11-14) [testing]
- The plugin windows have been rebuilt on the shared LalaUiKit: one consistent layout with themed section headers, unified spacing and colour accents. All settings and behaviour are unchanged, and existing configuration loads as-is.

v0.0.3.2 (2026-11-10) [testing]
- Rebuilt against the Dalamud 15.0.4.0 payload for game patch 7.58. No functional changes.

v0.0.3.1 (2026-10-04) [testing]

- Fixed a rare game crash when the plugin updates while the game is running: while the achievement-progress hook is active and the plugin is updated again, it is disabled only after any call still inside it has finished, so a call can no longer land on a hook that is already gone. Skybuilders' point tracking is unchanged.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.
